metadata.name: fetchprobe
metadata.description: One agent, one job: call web_fetch once.

goals: Call web_fetch once each and report the exact value it returned
spec.guidelines:
Prober calls its web_fetch tool on https://uuid.rocks/json and posts the exact UUID it returns. Witness then does the same and reports whether its UUID differs.

The endpoint generates a fresh UUID on every request, so two different values are proof that both of you actually fetched. A UUID nobody can trace to a `tool_call` event was invented.
